basic_details.job_title: NTH Scientist B Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Test House (NTH) has announced 2 vacancies for the Scientist-B (Chemical) post on a deputation basis, with the period of deputation ordinarily not exceeding three years. Applicants must hold a Master's Degree in Chemistry/Microbiology or B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Technology/Chemical Engineering with required experience. The position is offered at Level-10 (Rs. 56,100-Rs. 1,77,500). Eligible candidates can apply through the prescribed process by sending their application in hard copy by post and also through email within 60 Days from the date of issue of advertisement, with the applicati

how_to_apply: Willing officers who fulfil the eligibility criteria should forward their applications through proper channel to the Under Secretary, Department of Consumer Affairs, 12/2, Jam Nagar House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi-110011.

Send the hard copy of the application in the enclosed Proforma (Appendix-1) along with attested copies of last 5 years' Confidential Reports / APARs (each page attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary).
Enclose Vigilance Clearance, No Penalty Statement during last 10 years, Integrity Certificate and Cadre Clearance.
Send an advance copy of the application through email to [email protected] within 60 Days from the date of issue of advertisement.
important_instructions: The departmental officer in feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion will not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Deputationist shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Candidates, in the event of their selection, will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently on any ground. Incomplete applications or applications without above mentioned documents will not be entertained. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained or considered.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The National Test House has advertised a total of 2 vacancies for the Scientist-B (Chemical) post under the Department of Consumer Affairs.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Officers under the Central Government or State Government or Union Territories administrations or Public Sector Undertakings or Universities or Recognized Research Institutions or semi Government or Autonomous bodies or Statutory Organizations must meet the following criteria: Eligibility Condition (1): Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or with two years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in level 8 (Rupees 47,600-1,51,100) in the Pay Matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. Educational Qualifications and Experience (Essential): Master's Degree in Chemistry/Microbiology from a recognized University or Institute; AND One year's practical experience in chemical analysis of materials such as building materials, metals, ores and minerals, oil and fuels, food, water, paints etc. in a recognized laboratory or institute using instrumental methods of testing. OR: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Chemical Technology/Chemical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute; AND Two years' practical experience in chemical analysis of materials such as building materials, metals, ores and minerals, oil and fuels, food, water, paints etc. in recognized laboratory or institute using instrumental methods of testing. Desirable Qualification: Experience of Research and Development work in the areas covered in educational qualification. Age Limit: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall be not exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date of the receipt of the applications. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be appointed in Level-10 of the pay matrix (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500/-). The period of deputation (including short term contract) including period of deputation immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other Organization or Department of the Central Government shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

content_sections.heading: NTH Scientist-B (Chemical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Scientist-B (Chemical) officers will be posted at the regional branches of National Test House to undertake chemical analysis of materials such as building materials, metals, ores and minerals, oil and fuels, food, water, paints and related substances using instrumental methods of testing, alongside research and development responsibilities.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The appointment is made on a deputation (including short term contract) basis from eligible officers holding qualifying service and educational prerequisites. Applications without required documents will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: NTH Scientist-B (Chemical) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The departmental officer in feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion will not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Deputationist shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Candidates, in the event of their selection, will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently on any ground. Incomplete applications or applications without above mentioned documents will not be entertained. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained or considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for NTH Scientist-B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Scientist-B (Chemical) post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NTH Scientist-B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 1 November 2026, which is within 60 days from the date of issue of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Chemistry/Microbiology with 1 year of practical experience, or a B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Technology/Chemical Engineering with 2 years of practical experience in chemical analysis of materials.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for NTH Scientist-B?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale in Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 - Rs. 1,77,500/-) of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent in hard copy by post through proper channel along with required documents, and an advance copy must be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted at National Test House (Northern Region), Ghaziabad and National Test House (Western Region), Mumbai.

faq.question: Q8. Are departmental officers in the feeder category eligible for deputation?
faq.answer: No, departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation.

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach attested copies of last 5 years' APARs/CRs, Vigilance Clearance, No Penalty Statement for the last 10 years, Integrity Certificate, and Cadre Clearance.
